# Pipeline

## Run order

`analysis/pst/run_pst_pipeline.R` orchestrates the full sequence below in
order; each step can also be run standalone.

| # | Script | Writes |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `analysis/pst/02_ingest/parse_crc_freshwater_harvest.R` | `analysis/pst/outputs/crc_freshwater_harvest_2010_2024_tidy.csv` |
| 2 | `analysis/pst/02_ingest/multi_fishery_creel_summary.R` | `analysis/pst/outputs/multi_fishery_creel_trips.csv` + harvest/QA/ledger |
| 3 | `analysis/pst/02_ingest/district_creel_ingestion.R` | `analysis/pst/outputs/district_creel_summary.csv` |
| 4 | `analysis/pst/02_ingest/interview_proportions.qmd` | `analysis/pst/outputs/interview_mode_location_props.csv` |
| 5 | `analysis/pst/03_analysis/pst_fw_angler_trips_assembly.R` | the deliverable + three ledgers |
| 6 | `analysis/pst/03_analysis/pst_fw_build_jim_workbook.R` | `PST_FW_Jim_Update.xlsx` |

Steps 1–4 are independent and parallelizable. Step 5 is the only writer of
the deliverable, and it is re-runnable at any time — it reads whatever is
present and logs whatever isn't. Step 6 runs after step 5: the Excel export
was split out of the assembly script into its own step so the workbook
build can be re-run without re-running the tier hierarchy.

## Registry

| Artifact | Role |
|---|---|
| `input_files/pst/lookup_tables/pst_input_manifest.csv` | Registered inputs — one row per source file/table, with tier, block, and expected coverage |
| `input_files/pst/lookup_tables/pst_river_block_crosswalk.csv` | Fishery → river → block mapping (164 rows) |
| `analysis/pst/02_ingest/multi_fishery_creel_summary.R` | Merged effort + harvest; single DB fetch, one `est_pe_effort()` and one `est_pe_catch()` per fishery, so trips and harvest are identical by construction |
| `analysis/pst/02_ingest/district_creel_ingestion.R` | Pre-computed district totals not run through this repo's PE estimators — R3 (Todd Miller: Hanford/Yakima/McNary), R1 (Jeremy Trump: Snake River), R4 (Nathanael Overman: Green-Duwamish), and R2 (Chad Jackson: Upper Columbia, received 2026-08-28 as a single combined district-wide total, not a workbook) |
| `analysis/pst/02_ingest/interview_proportions.qmd` | Track B engine — conditional mode proportions from interviews |
| `analysis/archive/integrate_manual_runs.R` | Archived — not part of the current run order. Reconciles per-fishery `fw_creel.Rmd` runs to the monthly batch grain |
| `analysis/pst/03_analysis/pst_fw_angler_trips_assembly.R` | Reads the manifest, applies the tier hierarchy, writes deliverable + three ledgers |
| `analysis/pst/03_analysis/pst_p2_block_ratio.R` | Sourced by the assembly script. Tier P2: within-block CRC-harvest-ratio expansion for real (non-projected) years |
| `analysis/pst/03_analysis/pst_crc_harvest_projection.R` | Sourced by the assembly script. Tier P3, called twice with different `CRC_PROJECTION_CONTROL`: a 6-year trailing mean for WACoast + the four Columbia blocks, and (added 2026-08-21) Puget Sound's own same-parity (odd-year) 5-year mean — its odd-year Pink-salmon dominance makes a trailing mean understate an odd target year like 2025. Also a separate diagnostic comparing NEPA's 5-year even/odd mean catch to the same statistic reconstructed from pure CRC — see the outputs table below |
| `analysis/pst/03_analysis/pst_crc_projection_season_check.R` | Standalone, run manually — not in `run_pst_pipeline.R`'s `STEPS` yet (added 2026-08-28). Cross-references P3's projected 2025 CRC areas against `pst_season_status_lookup.csv` (below) and zeroes/caps any area confirmed closed by regulation. See that script's own header for why this is a human-verified lookup table rather than a live WDFW scrape |
| `input_files/pst/lookup_tables/pst_season_status_lookup.csv` | Hand-maintained, one row per (CRC area, month of 2025); `status` = `open`/`closed`/`restricted`/`UNVERIFIED`. Scaffolded and upserted (never overwritten) by `pst_crc_projection_season_check.R` above — same "empty until a human fills it in" mechanism as `SEASON_TRUNCATED_MONTHS` in `pst_p2_block_ratio.R` |

::: {.callout-note}
`input_files/pst/` is organized by provider rather than by file type:
`CRC/` (the CRC freshwater harvest workbooks), `R1_creel/` (Jeremy Trump's
Snake River annual summary), `R2_creel/` (Chad Jackson's Upper Columbia
total, received 2026-08-28 as a PDF-captured email table, not a workbook),
`R3_creel/` (Todd Miller's mid-Columbia and Yakima workbooks), `R4_creel/`
(Nathanael Overman's Green-Duwamish raw interviews and effort estimates),
`external_data/` (JSR tables, FEIS, NEPA, ODFW/LCR), and `lookup_tables/`
(the manifest and crosswalk above, plus `crc_area_lut.csv` and
`creel_fishery_catch_group_lut.csv`).
:::

`input_files/pst/lookup_tables/pst_input_manifest.csv` is one row per input,
machine-readable, with `tier`, `period_basis`, `unit_declared`, `status`,
and `blocking`. The assembly script reads it and refuses to run silently
past anything flagged `blocking`.

`input_files/pst/lookup_tables/pst_river_block_crosswalk.csv` is 164 rows, generated from
the branch's own data, resolving every creel fishery-year and provider
river to a block, a delivery river label, and its CRC areas. Every fishery
resolved cleanly; there are no `REVIEW` rows.

Two source_id conventions exist alongside `creel_pe`/`R3_external`/`R1_external`:
`CRC_only` (`tier = "NO_SURVEY"`) marks a river with real CRC harvest but no
creel/interview program at all — added so that harvest reaches P2 block-ratio
expansion instead of sitting outside the crosswalk invisibly. `ColumbiaMainstem`
(`tier = "OUT_OF_SCOPE"`) documents the actual mainstem CRC areas (dam-to-dam
reach segments, not tributaries); these rows are filtered out at crosswalk
load time (`attach_crosswalk_block()`'s loader) and never reach P2 — kept only
so the exclusion is a documented decision, not an unexplained gap.

Columbia tributaries split into four region-derived blocks (2026-08-19) — CRC's own
`region` field, not a hand-assigned "ColumbiaTrib" label, which masked that Hanford
Reach and McNary are in the same CRC region (`"Columbia - Upper"`) as several areas
correctly excluded as mainstem, and different regions from Cowlitz/Lewis/Drano:

| Block | Rows | Primary source | Delivered? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Puget Sound | 60 | mix of `creel_pe` and `CRC_only` (P2 candidates) | Yes |
| WA Coast | 46 | mix of `creel_pe` and `CRC_only` (P2 candidates) | Yes |
| Columbia Lower | 24 | `creel_pe` (Lower Cowlitz — `NO_DATA`), `CRC_only` (Cowlitz/Lewis system and small Lower-Columbia tributaries) | Yes |
| Columbia Middle | 7 | `creel_pe` (Drano Lake), `CRC_only` (Klickitat, Wind, Big White Salmon) | Yes |
| Columbia Upper | 24 | `R3_external` (Hanford Reach, McNary, Yakima), `R2_external` (Chad Jackson's combined Upper Columbia total, added 2026-08-28 — see MD6 in status/gaps), `CRC_only` (Methow — deliberately left active pending an R2 scope question — plus the mainstem stretch above Chief Joseph Dam, split 2026-08-28 from the row reclassified from ColumbiaMainstem) | Yes |
| Columbia Snake | 6 | `R1_external` (Snake River, resolving the crosswalk gap this doc used to flag) | Yes |
| Columbia mainstem | 2 | ODFW (Buoy 10 / below Bonneville, Bonneville–McNary) | **No — consultant-supplied, out of scope; rows exist for documentation only and are filtered at load** |

## Outputs

Assembly emits the deliverable plus three ledgers, which is what lets the
status children report status rather than assert it:

| File | Grain | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `pst_fw_trips_by_mode_location_INTERMEDIATE.csv` | block × river × year × mode × location | **Intermediate — not the deliverable.** Trips + paired total-salmon harvest + `trips_per_salmon`. |
| `pst_fw_trips_by_crc_area_INTERMEDIATE.csv` | block × river × **CRC area** × year × mode × location | Same as above but retains `catch_area_code` — **use this one for CRC joins** |
| `pst_fw_p2_block_ratios.csv` | block × year | Paired trips-per-salmon derived from the merged creel run |
| `pst_fw_p2_area_ratios.csv` | CRC area (and block × year) | Ratios from the P2 module in `pst_p2_block_ratio.R`, across all five pooling tiers (`ratio_basis`: `system_year`, `block_year`, `system_pooled`, `block_pooled`, `columbia_pooled` — finest-first cascade, see `estimate_block_ratios()`'s docstring). Distinct from `pst_fw_p2_block_ratios.csv` above — both are written, and they are not the same artifact |
| `pst_fw_p2_donors.csv` | recipient area × donor area | Which surveyed areas each unsurveyed area borrowed from (rule R4: donors are within-block only) |
| `pst_fw_p2_loo_detail.csv` | held-out area × year | Leave-one-out validation, row level |
| `pst_fw_p2_loo_summary.csv` | block | LOO rollup; `median_ape` feeds `p2_median_error_pct` in the Jim workbook |
| `pst_fw_crc_vs_creel_bias.csv` | CRC area × year | CRC vs design-based creel harvest, same area-year |
| `pst_fw_crc_projection.csv` | CRC area × year (2025 only) | Tier P3 (`pst_crc_harvest_projection.R`): 2025 trips for areas with no P1 and no real P2, expanded from a projected CRC harvest through the same ratio machinery P2 uses. Combines both control variants' rows — WACoast/Columbia-block areas from the 6-year trailing mean, Puget Sound areas from the same-parity 5-year mean (added 2026-08-21) — see that script's header |
| `pst_fw_crc_projection_sanity.csv` | CRC area | P3's projected harvest (either variant) vs. partial actual 2025 CRC (Jan–Mar), where available |
| `pst_fw_crc_projection_coverage.csv` | CRC area | Which candidate P3 areas were projected vs. excluded, and why |
| `pst_fw_crc_projection_worklist.csv` | CRC area (2025 only) | Written by `pst_crc_projection_season_check.R` — every P3-projected area, with the two license-year pamphlets (2024-25, 2025-26) that need a regulatory check. The "where to look" list, refreshed every run |
| `pst_fw_crc_projection_season_corrected.csv` | CRC area (2025 only) | Written by `pst_crc_projection_season_check.R` — P3's projection cross-referenced against `pst_season_status_lookup.csv`, with harvest/trips zeroed (fully closed) or prorated (partially closed) where verified. **Diagnostic only as of 2026-08-28 — does not feed back into `pst_fw_crc_projection.csv` or the deliverable automatically**; every area starts `UNVERIFIED` until a human checks it |
| `pst_fw_nepa_vs_pure_crc_comparison.csv` | NEPA stream × even/odd | **Diagnostic only — not consumed by the deliverable.** `pst_crc_harvest_projection.R`'s PART 2: NEPA's own 5-year even/odd mean catch per Puget Sound stream vs. the same statistic reconstructed from pure (pre-creel-substitution) CRC, split by whether the stream is creel-covered (`source_id == "creel_pe"` in the crosswalk). Quantifies the creel-substitution effect; written only if the NEPA workbook is present |
| `pst_fw_effort_long.csv` | + month, fishery_name | Audit trail / re-aggregation |
| `pst_fw_provenance_ledger.csv` | river-year × tier × source | Which number came from where |
| `pst_fw_gap_register.csv` | source × severity | Every blocker, gap, defect, and decision |
| `pst_fw_crc_coverage.csv` | CRC area | Feeds the status map |

Every deliverable row carries `tier` and `source_id`. There are no
unattributed numbers.

- **Provenance ledger** — tier, source_id, method per row
- **Gap ledger** — every skipped or absent input, with reason
- **Coverage ledger** — river-year × track completion
